description: config.v2 §2.3, §3: the record of the test contract `contracts/rfcfg.v1.toml`, whose derived Record derive.json gives. Written by an independent reading of the text (Python, standard library), checked, never blessed. `layout` is the Record's tag, the sha256 of its layout form's JCS bytes, and its shortest and longest record in bits. `writes`: an owner's `state`, as config.v2 reads a record, and the deployment `epoch` in seconds -> `fields`, the Record's JSON reading (core §7.6: a time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch, an absent optional field no member), `bits` before the pad, `hex` the record's bytes, `mutation` the put's payload under `stamp` {run_width, run, seq} (core §7.5, form 0), and `value` a reply's payload under the same stamp (form 2). A state is: instance (the instance's first run), revision, floor_s, would_be; pending, null or {token, groups (the contract's order), apply_at (null when no reach group waits), deadline, applied (true when apply_at is null)}; last, null or {token, groups}; desired, null or {outcome, observed_revision, refusal: null or {code, group (null for one the contract does not declare), parameter (null for a group's own check, or one the group does not declare)}}; groups, each {writable (a hot or reach group alone), params: each {source (null when the value is unknown), differs and value (null when unknown), both left out for a sensitive parameter}}. Instants are milliseconds since the Unix epoch, whole seconds. Every write reads back to its state. `reads`: a record's bytes, its CH tag and the epoch -> {state} or {refused: token}: first core §7.6's refusals (tag, length, code, extension, length, pad), then config.v2's, the first that applies: group (a group behind a marker whose writable, pending and last bits are not all present, or whose parameter has a value field and no differs bit; a group with none of its fields is absent, a writer of an earlier revision's), pending (pending_token and pending_deadline not both present or both absent; pending_apply_at, or a group's pending bit, with no pending_token; a pending_token with no group's pending bit), last (last_token with no group's last bit, or a last bit with no last_token), desired (desired_revision, desired_code, desired_group or desired_parameter without desired; desired without desired_revision; desired_code absent for refused or failed, or present for converged; desired_group without desired_code; desired_parameter without desired_group; an index the contract's groups, or that group's parameters, do not reach), parameter (a non-sensitive parameter's value without its source, its source without its value, or differs set with no value). `growth` reads two revisions of one contract: `groups` as derive.json declares each, `records` each revision writes, read by each, and `reads` of the later revision's records, read by it.

writes.note: an owner at its start: revision 0, nothing pending, no last change, every value from its startup layers; queue outside the allowlist; pin's source alone
idle with a last change: a hot set of duty, its value differing from the startup value
a reach change armed and not applied: apply_at present, the reply a reach set gets
the change applied, duty joined: the groups as bits in the contract's order, not the order they joined in
a dry run's record: would_be, the request's values at runtime, nothing else moved
a 32-bit run: the instance and the token's run as the owner drew them; a sensitive value set at runtime shows its source alone
a desired document refused for a sensitive parameter: the group's and the parameter's indices
refused for a reach group: a group's own check names no parameter
refused for a group the contract does not declare: no index, since the record carries no name
refused for a parameter duty does not declare: its group, and no parameter
failed, the rate spent; the largest revision the record holds
a value unknown after an undo that failed: neither source nor value
a deployment epoch: times count from it, so the same instants take small codes
the same instants with no epoch: Unix seconds
each bound: the largest floor and revision, a value at its maximum and one at its minimum

a deadline and no pending token

a desired revision and no report
